messages:
emily_cs: Heads-up — seeing onboarding jobs for three priority accounts hit fallback to hosted and long tail latencies (4-8s) during model warmup. Affected: AtlasCo (onboarding), Lendly (pilot), Nimbus Health (sensitive). We need a customer-facing status + mitigation plan. @raj_eng_oncall can you confirm root cause and ETA?
emily_cs: Impacting embedding uploads and first-query response times, customers reporting timeouts in their onboarding scripts.
raj_eng_oncall: looking now. initial signal: node pool in dedicated us-west-2 hit OOM from a quantized runtime regression after last rollout. Autoscaler tried to spin up but hit image-pull throttling, then requests routed to hosted.
raj_eng_oncall: oncall created a mitigation runbook, rolling back runtime patch on the affected pool, starting `kubectl rollout undo` for the runtime DaemonSet.
kevin_sre: image-pull throttling is because of docker hub rate from our CI account. I've queued a pull-through cache fix and raised priority with infra. Should be ~25-40m to stabilize if rollback works.
sofia_csm: thanks. I need a short customer update to send now — they want notice and expected next steps. Also: renewal risk alert for AtlasCo — they're in Q2 renewals, flagging this as a risk.
maria_csm: I can take Nimbus Health and Lendly comms. Drafting a note.
emily_cs: draft should include what happened, mitigation, expected ETA, and offering 1 week of onboarding credit + 1:1 QA session. Keep tone apologetic but actionable.
sofia_csm: draft (short): "Hi <AccountTeam>, we're investigating elevated onboarding latency affecting some model warmups. Engineering is rolling back a recent runtime patch and we expect stabilization within 30-60 minutes. We're proactively replaying your queued uploads and will ensure no data loss. We're offering a one-week onboarding credit and a dedicated 1:1 with our enablement team. We'll post an update in 30 minutes or sooner. — Sofia, Redwood CS"
emily_cs: good. add: "If you see timeouts, retry; we will not count failed onboarding attempts against your quota during the incident."
maria_csm: sending to Nimbus Health now. pinging their technical contact to schedule the QA session.
sofia_csm: can legal_ops confirm wording for credits and contractual language? ping @legal_ops
legal_ops: confirm ok for 1 week onboarding credit and scheduling mitigation calls. For anything beyond credits (SLA breach), escalate to partnerships/legal.
raj_eng_oncall: rollback in progress: `kubectl rollout undo daemonset/runtime -n redwood-serving` ; observing pods terminating and new pods with previous image coming up. Logs show warmup latency dropping on first checks.
ops_incident_bot: Incident 2026-03-03T15:12Z — runtime-rollback initiated by raj_eng_oncall. Status: in_progress.
kevin_sre: cache fix started, but verbose image pulls will continue for a bit. Estimated fully healthy: 45m.
emily_cs: update to customers: use Sofia's text + add ETA 45m and contact for the QA session link. Also add apology and ask if they'd like a live call.
sofia_csm: sending to AtlasCo, Lendly, Nimbus Health now. I'll paste thread below after responses.
maria_csm: Nimbus asked for immediate 30-min call. I've scheduled and included eng oncall.
raj_eng_oncall: monitoring. will post when 50% of pods are back and when tail latency < 1s for >5min.
emily_cs: prod note for account teams: mark AtlasCo as "renewal at risk" and assign CSM follow-up. We'll offer an extended onboarding credit if they escalate.
sofia_csm: thanks all. after 45m we'll convene a quick post-incident sync to confirm outreach and any billing credits.
ops_incident_bot: Incident 2026-03-03T16:02Z — runtime-rollback complete. Status: resolved.
raj_eng_oncall: tail latencies back to baseline, rolling monitoring for 2 hours. I'll create RCA with root cause: runtime patch introduced an unexpected memory growth path when quantized models with long KV caches warmed; image-pull/backoff exacerbated failover time.
emily_cs: great, please tag the RCA with affected account IDs and timeline. CSMs: send one more update with outcome + offer of credits and postmortem invite.
sofia_csm: draft outcome note: "Update: the issue was resolved by rolling back the runtime patch and warming new pods. Onboarding flows are healthy. We will follow up with a short RCA and offer a one-week onboarding credit plus a technical QA session. Apologies for the disruption — we value your trust."
maria_csm: Nimbus accepted the credit and scheduled the QA for tomorrow. AtlasCo requested a deeper postmortem and product team presence — tagging renewal lead.
emily_cs: I'll open a renewal-risk play and loop partnerships. Thanks everyone for fast turnaround.
sofia_csm: closing thread — will post final messages and store templates in /cs/outreach/incidents for reuse.
